title: Software Engineer (Backend)
description: About AppNation We build AI-powered mobile apps that reach millions of users worldwide. Since 2021, AppNation has been creating products across AI, productivity, and mobile experiences. Our apps, including Genie, Translate AI, and Arch, have reached 90M+ users globally and ranked among the top apps in 30+ countries. We are a team of builders, designers, and engineers who move fast, take ownership, and create products used by millions. About the Role We’re looking for a Software Engineer (Backend) to build and improve the backend systems behind our AI-powered mobile apps. You’ll work on production services used by our mobile products, developing APIs, data flows, integrations, and AI-powered capabilities while learning to reason about reliability, scalability, and performance beyond just writing application code. This is a hands-on role where you’ll own features from implementation through testing and production, collaborate closely with experienced engineers, and continue developing your backend and system design skills. What You’ll Do Design, build, and maintain backend services and APIs using Node.js and TypeScript. Take ownership of backend features from implementation through testing, deployment, and production validation. Build and maintain integrations with internal services, third-party APIs, and AI providers. Develop AI-powered product capabilities and backend workflows that integrate with LLMs and AI services. Design and maintain relational data models using PostgreSQL and MySQL. Write efficient queries, create appropriate indexes, manage database migrations, and investigate database performance issues. Use Redis for caching and other appropriate backend workloads. Build reliable background jobs and asynchronous workflows and work with queue or messaging systems when needed. Write and maintain unit and integration tests as a standard part of development. Debug production issues using application logs, metrics, traces, and other available signals. Build and run applications using Docker and develop an understanding of how services are deployed and operated in containerized environments. Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and design decisions. Collaborate closely with mobile, AI, product, and infrastructure teams. Use AI-assisted development tools effectively for coding, testing, debugging, research, and productivity while validating generated output and maintaining engineering quality. Continuously improve the quality, maintainability, security, and performance of the systems you work on. What We’re Looking For 3+ years of professional backend software development experience. Strong hands-on experience with Node.js and TypeScript in production applications. Solid understanding of backend fundamentals including HTTP, REST APIs, authentication, authorization, error handling, and application security. Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL and MySQL, including data modeling, joins, indexes, transactions, migrations, and query optimization. Practical experience with Redis and an understanding of common caching patterns. Strong testing discipline and hands-on experience writing unit and integration tests. Experience building maintainable, testable APIs and backend services. Practical experience with Git, code review, and modern software development workflows. Hands-on experience with Docker and containerized development environments. Basic understanding of distributed systems concepts, asynchronous processing, concurrency, retries, timeouts, and failure handling. Familiarity with CI/CD and production deployment workflows. Experience building AI-powered features or integrating backend applications with LLMs, AI APIs, or AI services. Comfortable using modern AI-assisted development tools while understanding that generated code must still be reviewed, tested, and technically understood. Ability to investigate production issues instead of treating deployment as the end of the development lifecycle. Strong problem-solving skills, ownership, curiosity, and clear communication. Familiarity with Kafka, RabbitMQ, Pub/Sub, BullMQ, or another messaging or queueing technology. Familiarity with Go, Ruby, Elixir or another functional programming language. Familiarity with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB, Cassandra, DynamoDB, or similar technologies. Familiarity with Kubernetes and container orchestration concepts. Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform or another major cloud platform. Why AppNation? Build and scale products reaching millions of users globally. Work with talented people in a fast-moving AI-first environment. Take ownership and see your impact directly in the products you build. Grow quickly with opportunities to lead projects and shape technical decisions. Enjoy competitive compensation and benefits, including private health insurance, meal and commute support, relocation support, and flexible working options. Our Hiring Process Application Review → Interview → Technical Assessment → Final Interviews At AppNation, we set ambitious goals and challenge ourselves to build products that reach millions of people. We value curiosity, ownership, and continuous growth. If this role excites you and you're ready to make an impact, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now, we're excited to meet you!

title: Senior Software Engineer (Backend)
description: About AppNation We build AI-powered mobile apps that reach millions of users worldwide. Since 2021, AppNation has been creating products across AI, productivity, and mobile experiences. Our apps, including Genie, Translate AI, and Arch, have reached 90M+ users globally and ranked among the top apps in 30+ countries. We are a team of builders, designers, and engineers who move fast, take ownership, and create products used by millions. About the Role We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Backend) to design, build, and evolve the backend systems behind our AI-powered mobile apps. You’ll work on production systems that power mobile experiences used by millions of users, building reliable APIs, data-intensive services, asynchronous workflows, and integrations with AI and third-party platforms. This is a hands-on engineering role with strong ownership across system design, implementation, testing, performance, and production reliability. You’ll also help raise the engineering bar through technical decisions, code reviews, mentoring, and better development practices. What You’ll Do Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services and APIs using Node.js and TypeScript. Own backend features from technical design and implementation through testing, deployment, observability, and production validation. Design reliable distributed and asynchronous workflows using message brokers, queues, background workers, and event-driven patterns. Build AI-powered product capabilities and integrate backend systems with LLMs, AI providers, and internal AI platforms. Design and optimize relational data models using PostgreSQL and MySQL, including indexing, query optimization, migrations, transactions, and concurrency considerations. Use Redis effectively for caching, distributed coordination, rate limiting, queues, and other appropriate workloads. Design systems with failure in mind, applying appropriate timeout, retry, idempotency, fallback, backpressure, and graceful-degradation strategies. Write comprehensive unit and integration tests and contribute to end-to-end testing of critical product flows. Investigate production issues using logs, metrics, traces, and profiling; identify root causes and implement lasting improvements. Contribute to architectural decisions, technical design reviews, code reviews, and engineering standards. Work effectively with Docker and containerized environments and understand how backend services operate on Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure. Collaborate closely with mobile, AI, product, and infrastructure teams to turn product requirements into reliable technical solutions. Use modern AI-assisted development tools effectively for coding, testing, debugging, research, and engineering productivity without compromising correctness or code quality. Mentor other engineers and help improve engineering practices across the team. What We’re Looking For 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong hands-on ownership of production backend systems. Strong production experience with Node.js and TypeScript. Strong understanding of backend fundamentals, including HTTP, REST APIs, authentication, authorization, concurrency, networking, and application security. Strong experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL and MySQL, including schema design, indexing, query execution and optimization, transactions, locking, migrations, and data integrity. Strong experience with Redis and a solid understanding of caching strategies, invalidation, and appropriate in-memory data patterns. Hands-on experience designing distributed systems and reasoning about scalability, reliability, consistency, concurrency, and failure modes. Production experience with asynchronous and event-driven systems using Kafka, RabbitMQ, Pub/Sub, or similar technologies. Strong understanding of patterns such as idempotency, retries, timeouts, eventual consistency, message delivery semantics, and failure recovery. Strong testing discipline, including unit and integration testing, mocking, testable design, and automated quality checks. Hands-on experience with Docker and familiarity with Kubernetes concepts and containerized production environments. Working knowledge of Google Cloud Platform and fundamental cloud concepts such as compute, networking, IAM, managed databases, storage, and observability. Experience debugging and improving production systems using metrics, logs, traces, and other observability signals. Familiarity with CI/CD workflows and modern software delivery practices. Experience building AI-powered backend capabilities and integrating applications with LLMs, AI APIs, or AI platforms. Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools as part of the daily engineering workflow while independently validating architecture, correctness, security, and maintainability. Strong ownership, technical judgment, communication skills, and the ability to make pragmatic engineering decisions in a fast-moving product environment. Why AppNation? Build and scale products reaching millions of users globally. Work with talented people in a fast-moving AI-first environment. Take ownership and see your impact directly in the products you build. Grow quickly with opportunities to lead projects and shape technical decisions. Enjoy competitive compensation and benefits, including private health insurance, meal and commute support, relocation support, and flexible working options. Our Hiring Process Application Review → Interview → Technical Assessment → Final Interviews At AppNation, we set ambitious goals and challenge ourselves to build products that reach millions of people. We value curiosity, ownership, and continuous growth. If this role excites you and you're ready to make an impact, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now, we're excited to meet you!

title: Full Stack Engineer
description: Job Description We are looking for a Full Stack Engineer with strong engineering fundamentals, sound technical judgment, and a product mindset to help build our AI-powered products, including ChatBoss. You will own features end-to-end across web applications, backend services, system integrations, and data workflows. Note on our tech stack: We care more about strong fundamentals than specific tools, though familiarity with our core stack (TypeScript, React, NestJS/Node.js, Python/FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and Docker) will help you ramp up faster. Skills & Requirements 3+ years of experience building and maintaining production software across frontend and backend (CS/SE degree or equivalent practical experience). Strong programming fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, async execution) and ability to evaluate architectural trade-offs for scalability, performance, and maintainability. Solid grasp of web technologies (HTTP, browser behavior, state management, responsive UI, frontend performance) and backend API design with clear service boundaries. Strong knowledge of relational databases and SQL (data modeling, transactions, indexing, query optimization). Practical understanding of application security (auth, input validation, sensitive data handling) and modern delivery workflows (Git, CI/CD, Docker, automated testing, debugging). Effective use of AI-assisted development: breaking down problems, providing context, and critically verifying generated code for correctness, security, and maintainability. Strong ownership and communication skills to clarify requirements and drive features from design through release. Benefits Opportunity to work with experienced engineers, researchers, and academics. Support for master’s and PhD studies. Training opportunities in artificial intelligence and machine learning. Competitive performance-based compensation. Private health insurance, MultiNet meal card, birthday leave, and flexible benefits. DataBoss A.Ş. DataBoss is a technology company specializing in the development of innovative software solutions powered by artificial intelligence technologies. Our R&D activities focus on natural language processing, large language models, computer vision, autonomous systems, agentic control and processing. We develop AI-driven products and technologies, bringing together academic research and industry expertise to deliver innovative solutions for real-world challenges.
